scheme_name: Schemes Of HP Minorities Finance & Development Corporation
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a minority community (Sikhs, Muslims, Christians, Buddhists, Jains, or Parsis)
Applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh
Applicant’s annual income must be below Rs.98,000 in rural areas or Rs.1,20,000 in urban areas
benefits_summary: Loans up to Rs.5 lakh for self‑employment at 6 % interest and up to Rs.10 lakh for professional/technical education at 3 % interest.
documents_required: Himachali certificate issued by the executive magistrate
